left.title: California Voters Remove Aaron Persky, the Judge Who Gave a 6-Month Sentence for Sexual Assault
left.body: Aaron Persky, the California judge who drew national attention in 2016 when he sentenced a Stanford student to just six months in jail for sexually assaulting an unconscious woman, was recalled on Tuesday, according to The Associated Press. He is the first judge recalled in California in more than 80 years.
left.roundup: Residents of Santa Clara, California voted to recall Judge Aaron Persky, who controversially sentenced Stanford student Brock Turner to six months in prison after he was found guilty of sexually assaulting an unconscious woman. While some celebrated the decision, many on both sides of the aisle have argued that it is a setback for criminal justice, as it will encourage judges to impose harsher sentences on all defendants for fear of public backlash.

center.title: Voters remove California judge criticized over rape sentencing
center.body: Californians voted in a special election to unseat a state judge who drew worldwide condemnation for giving a six-month jail sentence to a Stanford University swimmer convicted of sexually assaulting an unconscious woman.
